regime.label: Early-cycle Protection build: OI doubling into an 84-day expiry, gamma flip converging on spot
evidence: The cumulative-GEX zero-crossing sits at ~1080 on the raw chain (skewed by the deep, low-turnover 910 put wall, 3,220 OI vs only 104 vol/day) — stripping that stale strike pulls the effective flip to ~1070, putting today's 1063.9 spot right on top of it.

Total OI has grown +101.6% in calls (4,533->9,139) and +128.1% in puts (4,875->11,118) over the last 5 sessions with 84 days still to expiry — a young back-quarter still forming its walls, not a settled pin.
25Delta skew is +2.12 (990 put IV 15.61% vs 1110 call IV 13.49%) — a persistent, moderate downside-protection bid typical of this build phase.
ATM IV 14.21% sits near the 5-day low (13.88% on 07/03), down from 17.35% five sessions ago even as spot rallied +5.0% — compression, not a fear premium.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 (Sep '26, 84 DTE) trades at 1063.9 (-1.3 today), 23.9 points above the 1040 max pain that has now held for 3 straight sessions. Put OI (11,118) outweighs calls (9,139) for a 1.22 P/C-OI ratio, though the largest single wall is the deep 910 put strike (3,220 OI) — a structural floor, not active support. The nearest live walls sit at 1080 calls (1,700 OI) and 1030 puts (697 OI), bracketing spot in a 50-point band. ATM IV of 14.21% is compressed near the 5-day low, pricing a 9.52-point 1-sigma daily move.
what_changed: Future -1.6 pts day/day (1065.5->1063.9) after a 5-session, +50.6-point rally (1013.3->1063.9, +5.0%) off the 06/27 low.
Put OI +293 (+2.7%, 10,825->11,118) outpaced call OI (-52, 9,191->9,139), pushing pc_oi_ratio to 1.22 from 1.18.
Call wall eased at 1080 (1,884->1,700 OI, -9.8%) while fresh call OI built at 1100 (766->898, +17.2%) and 1090 (867->896) — the wall migrating higher with spot.
Max pain held at 1040 for a 3rd session; ATM IV ticked up 0.33pt off the 5-day low (13.88%->14.21%) as the 25Delta bands shifted +10pts (call 1100->1110, put 980->990).
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over the last 5 sessions (06/27-07/07) S50U26 rallied +50.6 points (1013.3->1063.9, +5.0%) while total OI more than doubled — calls +101.6% (4,533->9,139), puts +128.1% (4,875->11,118) — confirming this September contract is still in its early-cycle build-out at 84 DTE, not a mature pin. Max pain tracked the rally higher in lockstep, drifting +30 points (1010->1040) and now stabilizing for 3 straight sessions, while ATM IV compressed -3.14 points (17.35%->14.21%) even as spot climbed, consistent with a Protection-zone build rather than a volatility event. The raw gamma flip has crept up toward ~1080 as new call OI stacked at 1080-1100, but spot's own advance has kept it running just below that level. The 25Delta skew stayed put-rich throughout (currently +2.12), the persistent index downside-protection bid this build phase implies. Net: a fast-building, put-skewed back-quarter with no dominant near-money wall yet — watch whether OI growth decelerates (Unwind risk) or a wall consolidates into a genuine pin as DTE shortens.

strategies.name: 1030/990 put debit spread (downside hedge)
strategies.rationale: Neutral-to-thin dealer gamma below the ~1070-1080 flip, a persistent +2.12 put-rich skew, and compressed 14.21% IV make cheap downside insurance the matrix-indicated structure for a still-building Protection-zone quarter at 84 DTE.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, ~8.5 pts (1030 put ask 17.6 minus 990 put bid 9.1), capped regardless of how far spot falls.
strategies.invalidation: This is a hedge, not a directional bet - but a sustained close above the 1080 call wall would argue for trimming or rolling it lower as the near-term case turns bullish.

strategies.name: 1080/1100 call debit spread (breakout participation)
strategies.rationale: The 1080 call wall sits right at the raw gamma flip; a push through it finds dealers thin-on-gamma on the way up, amplifying rather than damping the move - a defined-risk way to participate in that squeeze without carrying naked wall risk.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, ~9.5 pts (1080 call ask 20.3 minus 1100 call bid 10.8), width 20.
strategies.invalidation: A close back below 1060 (today's ATM) or renewed call-OI unwind at 1080 negates the breakout case.

S50U26.prediction: Bias is neutral-to-mildly-bullish while spot (1063.9) holds above the 1040 max pain and below the 1080 call wall; 3 straight sessions of flat max pain plus the firm +2.12 put-rich skew argue for continued range-building rather than a decisive break. Invalidation: a close beyond the 1030 near-put-wall (downside) or the 1080 near-call-wall (upside) with rising volume would signal the range has resolved.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice. SET50 options are cash-settled on the index with no physical delivery, so pinning/max-pain magnetism here is structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks; treat every wall or pin level as a tendency, not a guarantee, especially at 84 DTE where open interest is still forming.
